description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchModelFactory class, focusing on creation of search results, filters, search properties, and sort options within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package.

classes.name: SearchModelFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SearchModelFactory, testing creation and behavior of search results, filters, properties, and sort options.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ThingsModelFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: newSearchResult
methods.description: Creates a new empty SearchResult and verifies it has no next page and is empty.

methods.name: newSearchResultFromJson
methods.description: Creates a SearchResult from a JsonObject and verifies its contents.

methods.name: newSearchResultFromJsonString
methods.description: Creates a SearchResult from a JSON string and verifies its contents.

methods.name: newSearchResultEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an empty SearchResult reports no next page and is empty.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFilter1
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the first filter to SearchModelFactory.and() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFilter2
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the second filter to SearchModelFactory.and() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullOptionalFilters
methods.description: Checks that passing null among multiple filters to SearchModelFactory.and() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createAndFilterWithMultipleFilters
methods.description: Creates a logical AND filter with multiple mock filters and verifies the count of filters.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFilter1
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the first filter to SearchModelFactory.or() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFilter2
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the second filter to SearchModelFactory.or() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullOptionalFilters
methods.description: Checks that passing null among multiple filters to SearchModelFactory.or() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createOrFilterWithMultipleFilters
methods.description: Creates a logical OR filter with multiple mock filters and verifies the count.

methods.name: tryToCreateNotFilterWithNullFilter
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to SearchModelFactory.not() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNotFilter
methods.description: Creates a NOT filter and verifies it contains the original filter.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchPropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that creating a SearchProperty with null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchPropertyWithNullString
methods.description: Checks that creating a SearchProperty with null String throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSearchProperty
methods.description: Creates a SearchProperty with a valid path and verifies its string representation.

methods.name: tryToCreateSearchQueryWithNullFilter
methods.description: Checks that creating a SearchQuery with null filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: newSearchQueryReturnsExpected
methods.description: Creates a new SearchQuery with a mock filter and verifies it's not null.

methods.name: newSortOptionFromSingleEntry
methods.description: Creates a SortOption from a single SortOptionEntry and compares it to an expected value.
